node.statement: Writing B=V bold-dot (J+P+Q), the exact involution axioms of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra give B^dagger=(J+(P+Q)^dagger) bold-dot V^dagger and (B^dagger bold-dot B)^dagger=B^dagger bold-dot B without any reassociation; since J^dagger=J, Phi_V(P,Q)=(B^dagger bold-dot B-J)/2 belongs to H.
